articles.title: Yangel Herrera da la vuelta a sus números
articles.standfirst: El centrocampista venezolano cambió este verano en la Real el dorsal 12 por el 21, con el que destacó en el Girona, y su rendimiento ha mejorado y hasta en Elche marcó su primer gol
articles.summary: El centrocampista venezolano cambió este verano en la Real el dorsal 12 por el 21, con el que destacó en el Girona, y su rendimiento ha mejorado y hasta en Elche marcó su primer gol
articles.body: Yangel Herrera ha cambiado este verano el número 12 que lució la pasada temporada, la primera en la Real Sociedad, por el 21 con el que destacó en el Girona y lo cierto es que con el nuevo dorsal está mejorando mucho su rendimiento, tras dejar parece atrás sus problemas musculares. El centrocampista venezolano apunta a seguir en el equipo titular de Pellegrino Matarazzo el domingo contra el Atlético de Madrid. Herrera fue fichado tan tarde hace un año que le tocó el número 12 de una Real con la que, al llegar además lesionado, no pudo debutar hasta finales de octubre, jugando sólo dos partidos porque sufrió otro problema muscular que, con recaída incluida, le tendría de baja hasta el mes de febrero. No quedó ahí su infortunio, ya que un mes antes de la final volvió a tener una lesión que le dejó sin vestirse de corto en La Cartuja, pudiendo al menos despedir la campaña con algunas participaciones más con la Real y siendo llamado después por su selección. El de la Guaira volvió de las vacaciones y pudo completar con normalidad la pretemporada, aún eso sí con su antiguo dorsal, aprovechando el baile de números que hubo tras las bajas de algunos compañeros para hacerse con el 21 del que guardaba tan buen recuerdo de su etapa en el Girona. Es inevitable, por tanto, preguntarle que significa para él ese dorsal. “El año pasado ya lo pedí, pero ya lo tenía un compañero y no lo pude tener. Era algo que tenía en mete, es un número que para mí significa mucho y cada vez que puedo me gusta llevarlo y cuando no lo he llevado me he sentido un poco extraño. Durante los primeros días de pretemporada hablé con el compañero que lo tenía, con el director de fútbol Erik Bretos, con todos, porque quería llevarlo”. El resultado es que, ya con el 21 a la espalda, Herrera ha participado a día de hoy en los cinco encuentros oficiales que la Real ha disputado en LaLiga, en cuatro de ellos desde el inicio y ofreciendo sus mejores minutos y sumando su primer gol desde que aterrizó en San Sebastián, cuando hace un año por estas mismas fechas aún le queda más de un mes para poder debutar, siendo la esperanza en la entidad de Anoeta que goce de continuidad para que esos 11 millones de euros pagados por él tengan un rédito, al menos, deportivo. De momento, es feliz habiéndole dado la vuelta a los números, el de su camiseta y el de sus estadísticas en el campo. “Estoy contento, feliz, estoy jugando y disfrutando, después de venir del año pasado, que fue con mucho sufrimiento. Comenzar este jugando y aportando al equipo es algo muy valioso para mí y espero seguir así. ¿Mi primer gol? Tenía muchísimas ganas de poder marcarlo y gracia a Dios lo pude hacer y ayudar a los tres primeros puntos de visitante”.

articles.title: Strictly: New hosts explain their roles as they reject 'roving presenter' reports
articles.summary: Johannes Radebe, Josh Widdicombe and Emma Willis say their roles are not "fixed" or defined.
articles.body:
Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe have said they will not have "fixed roles" on Strictly Come Dancing, as they prepare to replace Tess Daly and Claudia Winkleman later this month.

Daly and Winkleman left the programme together at the end of the 2025 series.

Daly was the host on the dancefloor, introducing the dancers and judges, while Winkleman did the post-dance debrief upstairs in the "Clauditorium".

"No one's replacing anybody - at the minute it's all very kind of open," Willis told Richard Osman on The Rest is Entertainment podcast.

They also scotched reports of Radebe having a "roving reporter" role on the show, with Willis saying: "There's definitely no backstage roving reporter, which is what has been reported quite a bit."

Widdicombe added that they would "be like Total Football" [where players can take the role of anyone on the team], adding: "We're going to be moving everywhere".

Radebe added he will definitely be doing "a little bit of prying and finding out the truth", having been a professional dancer on the show, with the advantage of knowing everyone on it really well already.

He called his new role "very, very exciting," although he admitted he felt a "little bit of a tinge" of FOMO [fear of missing out] at seeing the pros in rehearsals.

They also added that the plan to put the three of them together was a "wild card decision" by producers, which took them all by surprise.

Willis explained the audition process, saying they had to do a "chemistry test" to see how they interacted as a group.

She said they were told: "This is the last one and this is a wild card. We're just like, 'What happens if we do three?'

"And they said, 'It's so much of a wild card, we don't really have a script for you either.

"'So we're going to sit down, get it up on the screen and we'll have a little tinker all together'."

Willis called the hiring process "the most cloak and dagger thing" she has ever seen, saying it took about four months in total and that the chemistry test was "terrifying, but so brilliant".

Widdecombe added that it was all so secretive that he had to tell his taxi driver he was testing for a show called The Great Garden Glow Up, if he was asked.

They all joked about how the three of them appear as a group, with Osman saying to Willis: "You and Johannes look good together."

Widdecombe responded: " Do you know what I have realised? It's difficult when you're paired with two of the most striking people on television."

Osman then quipped: "You do look a bit like a competition winner," to which Widdecombe agreed.

Radebe also admitted he will "struggle" with having to be impartial now he is not longer competing.

Osman asked him if the gloves would be off should the judges get overly critical of the new crop of contestants, and the dancer joked he was "waiting for that judges' debrief".

The show is returning with 15 celebrities competing for the glitterball trophy, including Australian singer Delta Goodrem, former England footballer Shaun Wright-Phillips, actresses Lacey Turner and Jaime Winstone and Team GB skeleton racer Tabby Stoecker.

Judges Shirley Ballas, Revel Horwood, Motsi Mabuse, and Anton Du Beke are also back for the new series, which starts on Saturday 19 September.

articles.title: España pasa a octavos tras firmar una goleada histórica
articles.standfirst: Iguala la mayor goleada histórica de los Mundiales Sub'20 con los once tantos ante Nueva Caledonia
articles.summary: Iguala la mayor goleada histórica de los Mundiales Sub'20 con los once tantos ante Nueva Caledonia
articles.body: España se clasificó para los octavos de final del Mundial Sub'20 tras golear (11-0) a Nueva Caledonia. Se trata de la mayor goleada histórica de la selección en la categoría y la más abultada en la historia de los Mundiales. El festival llevó la firma de Segura (4), Pau (2), Marisa (2), Cerrato, Julià y Rosalía. Aznar realizó siete cambios respecto al debut ante Nigeria. No varió la identidad de una España que saltó con todo al verde del Arena Sosnowiec. No tardó en mostrar su superioridad y hundir al rival prácticamente en su propio área. Las primeras ocasiones llegaron a balón parado y el primer gol llegó desde el costado zurdo. Fue Pau, en una excelsa jugada individual, quien dribló a dos rivales antes de fusilar a Aben desde el interior del área. España no cedió en su intensidad a pesar de abrir la lata. Así llegó el segundo, poco después, con un remate de primeras de Marisa a centro de Noe desde el costado diestro. Lo de la selección fue un toma y daca constante buscando el tercero. Marisa y Amaya tuvieron el gol en sus cabezas, la primera rematando al cuerpo de Aben y la segunda topándose con Pocoue-Kasouemi en línea de gol. Finalmente fue Segura, pasada la media hora, quien lograra el objetivo aprovechando una asistencia de Cerrato para meter, con toque sutil, el balón en la jaula. La conexión sería a la inversa poco después, siendo Segura la que asistiera con un pase filtrado y Cerrato quien definiera con mucha calidad. El quinto llegó en el tiempo de añadido con la firma de Marisa y un potente derechazo tras la asistencia de Amaya. España volvió a escena con todo y anotó tres goles en siete minutos. A los 35 segundos anotó Segura, de cabeza, a centro de Pau. Luego Agote, recambio en el descanso, ejerció de asistente de Comendador y la propia Segura. La propia Daniela lo intentó a la hora de juego con una rosca con mucha intención, pero el balón se estrelló en el poste. También con la madera, esta vez el travesaño, evitó el tanto de Julià con un disparo desde la medialuna. Segura alcanzaría el póker particular al transformar una pena máxima forzada por ella misma en un centro que tocó en la mano de una defensora. La árbitra volvió a señalar una pena máxima al ver un pisotón de Gondou sobre Rosalía, pero se echó atrás llamada por la Sala VOR. El décimo llegaría a dos minutos para el final, con la firma de Julià, con un zurdazo desde la frontal que se coló por la escuadra. La guinda llegó en el tiempo de añadido, un derechazo de Rosalía que besó las mallas. La estadística fue aún más abrumadora que el marcador (85% de posesión, 67 remates totales y 34 a puerta o los 31 córners son una buena muestra) y, una vez cumplido el primer objetivo -véase la clasificación para la fase de eliminatorias- el próximo reto es cerrar la fase de grupos, este domingo ante China, como primeras de grupo. Los once goles anotados frente a Nueva Caledonia es récord para la selección española Sub'20, superando el 6-0 a Países Bajos en un amistoso disputado en marzo, igualando el resultado más abultado en la historia de los Mundiales de la categoría, que hasta era el 11-0 que anotó Francia ante Fiji en la edición de 2024.

articles.title: 'They Are Unserious,' Lane Kiffin's LSU Ripped by SEC Insider After Trying to Roster Ex-NFL Players
articles.summary: In the wake of head coach Lane Kiffin and LSU's attempts to add former NFL players to its roster for the 2026 season, people in the SEC don't have many kind things to say about the program right now.
articles.body:
In the wake of head coach Lane Kiffin and LSU's attempts to add former NFL players to its roster for the 2026 season, people in the SEC don't have many kind things to say about the program right now.

One SEC administrator told ESPN's Dan Wetzel "they are unserious" when describing LSU.

"It's impossible to deal with LSU right now," the administrator added.

New report on ex-pros joining LSU's roster

Kiffin and the Tigers came under scrutiny from the SEC and NCAA for recruiting tight end Dae'Quan Wright and defensive tackle Zxavian Harris. Both of whom spent the summer on NFL rosters before being waived in August.

Neither player was on the active roster for LSU's season-opening win over Clemson. ESPN's Pete Thamel reported on Tuesday that Kiffin locked the Tigers' roster for the remainder of the season by adding two players, with Wright and Harris not making the cut.

The move came after the SEC had scheduled a vote of the conference presidents about potentially expelling LSU. Wetzel noted the chances of that happening are "essentially zero."

Even though Kiffin's attempts to add former pro players to the LSU roster were at the center of the divide between the program and SEC, Wetzel wrote the Tigers are seen as "forever pushing the envelope" between Kiffin and men's basketball coach Will Wade.

"Who is in charge there?" one SEC administrator told Wetzel. "And how do you ever trust them?"

Kiffin is in his first season at LSU after being hired in November following a six-year stint at Mississippi.

Amidst all of the roster controversy, Kiffin and the Tigers had a strong start to the season with an impressive 51-10 win over Clemson. LSU will play Louisiana Tech on Saturday before returning to Vaught–Hemingway Stadium for a much-anticipated showdown with Ole Miss on Sept. 19.

articles.title: Hearts 'have to be above emotions', says Wouter Vrancken before Stenhousemuir cup tie
articles.summary: Hearts head coach Wouter Vrancken insists there can be no excuses as his side prepare to face Stenhousemuir at Ochilview on Friday with a place in the Premier Sports Cup semi-finals at stake.
articles.body:
Hearts must "rise above the emotions" of being strong favourites away to Stenhousemuir on Friday with a place in the Premier Sports Cup semi-finals at stake, says head coach Wouter Vrancken.

The Tynecastle side are unbeaten in their past eight matches, but Vrancken is wary of the challenge posed by the surprise Scottish Championship leaders on their own artificial surface at Ochilview.

"It's not about Astro, it's not about stadium, it's not about all those things. Excuses are for losers, let's say," Vrancken said as he demands the same focus shown in the recent Edinburgh derby and European qualifiers.

"You have to prepare, you have to prepare yourself and you have to be ready. You have to cope with those things and be ready and be above.

"Like I told the players also before the Hibs game, we have to be above the emotions.

"Here also you have to be above the emotions. You are the favourites playing against the underdogs and this is a totally different situation as playing Benfica."

Visit our Hearts page for all the latest news, analysis and fan views

Get Hearts news notifications in the BBC Sport app

Stenhousemuir took Motherwell to exta time before winning 1-0 at Ochilview in round two.

"The game is 90 minutes, we don't have to decide the game in the first 15 minutes," added Vrancken.

"We will try from the first second to play our game and then we'll see where we get. The most important thing is going to the next round.

"Even when you don't score directly, you have to stay in your game. It's a cup game. You cannot underestimate the opponent. They're also there for a reason. They're a good side.

"We have to be ready to deal with it and to go our chances without thinking it's going to be easy. When you do this, then for sure you're lost already before the game. We have to be ready as well as mentally, as technically, as tactically."

Friday's tie marks the start of a demanding run of fixtures for Hearts, who face away trips to Falkirk and Kilmarnock over the following week.

With at least six Conference League matches still to come before Christmas, squad management will become increasingly important.

"This is the thing we want," continued Vrancken. "Otherwise we don't have to qualify for the league phase in Europe.

"You have to try to measure the fatigue and also talk with the players. At the moment you have to make a decision and you also have to have an eye on the players who maybe are stronger in those things.

"This is a lot of talking and feeling and trying to have objective numbers as much as possible to make decisions."

Stenhousemuir boss Marvin Bartley is yet to taste defeat over 90 or 120 minutes after 10 games in charge.

And the former Livingston manager talked of his players being on the "same wavelength" before Hearts' visit.

"We have clarity of everything we do, whether it be on the ball, whether it be off the ball, whether it be set-plays, whatever else it might be," he explained.

"We try and take the guessing out of it. A lot of people look at attacking and they think it has to have some sort of structure to it and when it comes to defending, it's kind of off the cuff. We're the opposite with that.

"We need to know when the ball's in certain situations, in certain areas of the pitch, how we're going to defend it."

Midfielder Lewis O'Donnell says the Warriors are benefiting from the freedom offered by Bartley.

"He tells us all when we get in that attacking area just to be creative, make things happen," the 21-year-old said.

"Don't be like a robot. Go and express yourself. I feel like all the boys have done that so far."

articles.title: Max Cleworth: Wrexham to be without defender for two months of Championship
articles.summary: Wrexham suffer blow with defender Max Cleworth ruled out for two months of the Championship after a hamstring injury.
articles.body:
Wrexham defender Max Cleworth has been ruled out for eight weeks with a hamstring injury.

Cleworth, 24, sustained the injury during the first half of Tuesday's 1-1 draw at home to Burnley.

"He overstretched the ball in a bit of a tangle and he just overstretched his hamstring," manager Phil Parkinson said.

"It is a bit more serious than we first thought, so he's going to be eight weeks out."

Cleworth had started the Red Dragons' last three fixtures and his absence will force Parkinson into a defensive reshuffle.

Wrexham travel to West Ham United on Friday, 11 September (20:00 BST) and then host Southampton on Saturday, 19 September before the international break.

Latest Wrexham news, analysis and fan views

Wrexham play five fixtures in October, with Parkinson confident the promotion hopefuls have sufficient cover.

He said: "Max came in and did well, he took his opportunity, but Zak Vyner was our best player in pre-season in America and started the season great against Middlesbrough and Cardiff.

"Also, Aaron James has done really well pre-season and we kept him here. We didn't let him go out on loan because we knew we needed him and trust him.

"Dom Hyam and Joe Worrell can all play in those positions so we've got options.

"We're frustrated for Max because he'd come back into the team and did really well but that's what we've got a squad for and we've got the players to make sure it won't hinder us too much."

Parkinson said the calf injury Josh Windass suffered against Burnley is not serious and the forward is available to face the Hammers.

"It was only a whack, we've had that scanned, so that's really positive news for us," he added.

"Everyone's got to remember with Josh that he's almost having his pre-season within the season.

"He didn't play a single minute in pre-season. We've got to manage his minutes and make sure that we get him right to where we need to be because he's a very important player for us.

"He is a player that produces real quality moments, as he showed last year."

Wrexham are also boosted by the return of midfielder Ben Sheaf, who is yet to feature this season.

Sheaf had been out with a calf injury but is in the travelling party for the trip to face second-placed West Ham at London Stadium.

articles.title: Los sportinguistas se alegran de escuchar a Sarco decir: "Estoy volviendo a ser yo"
articles.standfirst: El delantero, que apunta a la titularidad ante el Eldense, se marca el ascenso como objetivo
articles.summary: El delantero, que apunta a la titularidad ante el Eldense, se marca el ascenso como objetivo
articles.body: El mensaje se contagia. No solo la Directiva del Sporting de Gijón se ha fijado como objetivo el ascenso de categoría. El discurso ha calado en el vestuario rojiblanco y la ambición es notable dentro del equipo de Nicolás Larcamón. Los recién llegados también se empapan rápido de las ganas de devolver al Sporting a Primera división. Alejo Sarco no es la excepción. El delantero argentino estrenó su cuenta goleadora en Tenerife para dar comienzo a una temporada en Gijón que, confía, tenga el mejor de los finales. "Es el objetivo de cada uno de nosotros. Nos encontramos en un buen inicio de temporada, ojalá se siga dando así. Yo vine para sumar, aportar mi granito de arena para el objetivo de ascender. Quiero jugar en Primera división con el Sporting", explicó en una entrevista concedida a Radio MARCA Asturias. Tras despuntar en Argentina, el Bayer Leverkusen le echó el lazo en enero de 2025. Las lesiones le impidieron continuar con su gran progresión. Ahí se abrió la puerta del Sporting. "Pregunté a los españoles del Bayer por el Sporting. Ahí estaban Aleix García, Lucas Vázquez o Grimaldo, que ahora está en el Atlético. Me dijeron que era un club de Primera", asegura. Ahora en Gijón, Alejo Sarco busca cumplir el sueño de una afición que le ha cautivado desde el primer momento. Acostumbrado al calor del fútbol argentino, al delantero de Buenos Aires le entran buenos recuerdos en El Molinón. "El ambiente me hizo recordar a Argentina. El Molinón es increíble. En Alemania todo era más frío, más show", compara. Un halago que se va también a Mareo. "Es de primer nivel. Me mandaron el vídeo para ficharme", explicó entre risas. El delantero argentino busca hacerse un hueco en los planes de Larcamón. Tras aparecer como suplente en los últimos partidos, Sarco puede ser una de las novedades en el duelo ante el Eldense de este domingo. Todo tras darle la victoria al Sporting en Tenerife con su estreno goleador en España. "Para el delantero que se abra el arco es muy importante. Que sean muchos más. Me siento muy bien, con confianza. Estoy volviendo a ser yo. Le digo al cuerpo técnico que estoy con ganas, disfrutando mucho el día a día".

articles.title: La Premier recupera el 'Boxing Day'
articles.standfirst: La temporada pasada sólo hubo un partido y este curso se disputarán siete
articles.summary: La temporada pasada sólo hubo un partido y este curso se disputarán siete
articles.body: La Premier League ha cumplido su promesa y después de programar un solo partido en el 'Boxing Day' del año pasado, ha recuperado en esta ocasión esta tradición y ha fijado siete encuentros en este festivo día. La competición inglesa, además, ha anunciado el calendario para esa jornada con dos meses y medio de antelación, con el objetivo de que los aficionados puedan organizarse con tiempo suficiente para arreglar alojamientos y desplazamientos. La jornada 17 de la Liga inglesa, que se dividirá entre el 26 y el 27 de diciembre, empezará con un Aston Villa-Leeds United a las 12.30 hora local, seguido de cuatro partidos a las 15.00, entre ellos el Tottenham Hotspur-Bournemouth. A las 17.30 habrá un Hull City-Liverpool y a las 20.00 el Newcastle United-Manchester City. El 27 de diciembre se jugarán tres encuentros, el Coventry City-Chelsea, el Manchester United-Nottingham Forest y el Crystal Palace-Arsenal. La siguiente jornada después de la del 'Boxing Day' comenzará el 29 de diciembre, por lo que la competición se ha asegurado de que todos los clubes tengan al menos 60 horas de descanso entre un partido y otro.

articles.title: Cancelo: "Mi ilusión es ganar la Champions con el Barcelona"
articles.standfirst: El luso aplaude el buen arranque de los culés, pero reconoce que aún falta mucho
articles.summary: El luso aplaude el buen arranque de los culés, pero reconoce que aún falta mucho
articles.body: Cancelo sumó ayer su primera titularidad de la temporada y lo hizo contra el Feyenoord en la Champions. El luso tiene muchas esperanzas puestas en la máxima competición europea y espera poder levantar el título a final de temporada. Eso sí, aunque aplaudió el gran inicio, reconoció que el camino es largo. "Siempre es especial jugar en casa y en esta competición porque tengo la ilusión de ganarla con el Barcelona. Haremos todo para lograrlo. Queda mucho. Hay que ir paso a paso, pero estamos en el camino", explicó el jugador a los medios oficiales de la entidad. El objetivo de los culés era arrancar la Champions dando un golpe encima de la mesa y lo lograron contra el Feyenoord. "Teníamos que empezar con el pie derecho. El año pasado tuvimos algún mal sabor de boca en esta competición. Era importante ganar, lo hicimos y, además, firmamos un gran partido", explicó Cancelo. El portugués aún no había disfrutado de ninguna titularidad en este inicio de temporada. Contando las tres primeras jornadas de LaLiga, apenas disputó media hora en total. En cambio, el miércoles por la tarde, en Champions, salió de inicio y completó los 90 minutos.

articles.title: Newcastle: Matthias Jaissle questions booking compared to rival managers
articles.summary: Newcastle United head coach Matthias Jaissle has questioned why he was booked for his touchline behaviour after he felt some other animated managers were not.
articles.body:
Newcastle United head coach Matthias Jaissle has questioned why he was booked for his touchline behaviour after he felt some other animated managers were not.

The fourth official repeatedly reminded Jaissle to stay inside his technical area during last week's 2-2 draw against Bournemouth before he was eventually shown a yellow card by referee Rob Jones in the 70th minute for straying outside again.

After the game, at St James' Park, Jaissle contested the "benefit of that rule" if he was "just supporting and engaging with the team".

"I hope I don't need to adapt," the 38-year-old said a few days on. "I was really clear that I was disappointed.

"I made that also really clear in many aspects because, from my point of view, if you're 20cm outside your box and you encourage and support your own team in a positive way, an emotional way, I'm not sure if that's then a yellow card.

"Also compare when I'm looking at some of my colleagues."

Jaissle, who arrived from Saudi Pro League side Al-Ahli last month, is the only manager to have been cautioned in the Premier League in the opening weeks of the season.

When asked if there were other coaches who were as animated, who were not booked, Jaissle said: "You can say so."

A new charter on participant behaviour was introduced by the Premier League, the FA, the EFL and the Professional Game Referees in 2023, which specifies occupants must remain within their technical area during the match.

In pre-season, officials from the Premier League and the Professional Game Referees visited each top-flight club to update managers on operational matters and laws.

articles.title: Okafor no volverá a jugar con Suiza "bajo las órdenes" de Murat Yakin
articles.standfirst: El atacante del Leeds asegura que su decisión no se debe a sus pocos minutos con la 'Nati'
articles.summary: El atacante del Leeds asegura que su decisión no se debe a sus pocos minutos con la 'Nati'
articles.body: El delantero suizo del Leeds Noah Okafor, 26 veces internacional con la selección de su país, ha anunciado que no jugará más con el equipo nacional "bajo las órdenes del actual seleccionador", Murat Yakin, con el que ha protagonizado varias desavenencias en los últimos años. "Son las palabras más duras que he tenido que escribir durante mi carrera. Tras una cuidadosa reflexión, he decidido dejar el equipo nacional suizo hasta nuevo aviso", agregó el jugador en una carta publicada en sus redes sociales. En el escrito, Okafor menciona que en el reciente Mundial, para el que fue convocado pero en el que sólo disputó 13 minutos en el partido de dieciseisavos de final ante Argelia, "se quebró la confianza" y hubo varias decisiones que "le hirieron profundamente". "Sé que algunos dirán que estoy molesto porque apenas jugué, pero insisto, mi decisión no tiene nada que ver con mi tiempo en el campo", aseguró el jugador, que ya tuvo encontronazos con Yakin en la anterior Copa del Mundo de Qatar 2022 y en la Eurocopa 2024, en las que tampoco figuró entre los titulares. Pese a su enfrentamiento con el seleccionador, Okafor elogió en su carta el "excelente trabajo" de Yakin al frente de la 'Nati', y aseguró que el entrenador "ha escrito una página de la historia de Suiza, por lo que su éxito le da la razón a él y a su equipo". Okafor, formado en el Basilea y que también ha jugado en las ligas de Austria (Red Bull Salzburgo) e Italia (Milan y Nápoles), ha marcado sólo dos goles con la selección absoluta, aunque también tiene en su haber tres tantos con la sub 17 y uno con la sub 19. La Federación helvética confirmó que ha recibido de parte de Okafor su anuncio de 'retirada', tras lo cual señaló que respeta su decisión y le desea "mucha suerte y éxito en su club".

articles.title: Washington Spirit sign Clara Luvanga: Is deal a world record transfer?
articles.summary: Tanzanian striker Clara Luvanga has joined Washington Spirit from Al-Nassr in a deal believed to be one of the most costly in the history of women's football - and possibly one that sets a world record.
articles.body:
Tanzanian striker Clara Luvanga has joined the Washington Spirit from Saudi Arabian club Al-Nassr in a deal believed to be one of the most costly in the history of women's football.

The fee paid by the National Women's Soccer League side has not been officially disclosed.

Some are reporting it to be $2.3m , external (about £1.7m), which would make Luvanga the most expensive female footballer in history.

BBC Sport has not been able to verify this figure, although a well-placed source said they believed it ranked in the top five most expensive signings in the women's game.

The Spirit declined to comment on the fee involved when contacted by BBC Sport.

Luvanga, 21, has signed a contract running to the end of the 2029 NWSL season.

If the reported record figure is correct, it would mean the fee passes the £1.4m that London City Lionesses are said to have paid to Paris St-Germain for Grace Geyoro last year.

However, the Geyoro fee has been disputed, further illustrating how transfer figures in the women's game are often kept private.

With her move, Luvanga becomes the first Tanzanian player in NWSL history.

Luvanga won the Saudi Women's Premier League in all three of her seasons with Al-Nassr, as well as the Saudi Women's Cup, Saudi Women's Super Cup and West Asian Football Federation (WAFF) Women's Clubs Championship.

She also claimed the league's golden boot last season after scoring 24 goals in 14 appearances.

The Washington Spirit are owned by Michele Kang, who also owns London City Lionesses.

London City made a series of high-profile signings during the summer transfer window, including two-time Ballon d'Or winner Alexia Putellas who arrived from Barcelona on a three-year deal.

Luvanga made her senior international debut for Tanzania in 2024. Before joining Al-Nassr in 2023, she played for DUX Logrono in Spain, having developed through the youth system at Tanzanian club Yanga Princess.

When discussing her new club, Luvanga said: "I am very excited to join the Washington Spirit and to take on this new challenge in the NWSL.

"I know I am arriving with the season already under way, but I'm really excited to play in a new league and a new country."

Spirit sporting director James Hocken said: "Clara adds an exciting new dimension to our attack as we head toward the play-offs.

"Despite her young age, she has demonstrated the ability to score goals in different ways and has the profile to be very successful in this league."

Inspired by Ronaldo, dancing her way to the top - analysis

Luvanga's rise from Tanzania to one of the world's most competitive women's football leagues has been remarkably rapid.

She began her career with Yanga Princess in her native country before her big international breakthrough came in August 2023, when she joined Spanish side DUX Logrono. But Spain was only a brief stop on her career journey.

By October of that year, Luvanga headed for Saudi Arabia to join Al-Nassr, a move that would prove transformative for her career.

Over three seasons in the Middle East, she helped Al-Nassr win the Saudi Women's Premier League title each time, establishing herself as one of the division's most prolific forwards.

Her time at Al-Nassr also provided an opportunity to meet one of football's biggest stars, Cristiano Ronaldo , who plays for Al-Nassr's men's team. Luvanga has spoken about modelling aspects of her own career on the Portuguese forward.

"The focus and determination that he has, when you look at his life, I wish to live like that," she told BBC Sport Africa in 2025.

There is another side to the Tanzanian forward that goes beyond the goals.

Her former team-mate at Al-Nassr, goalkeeper Sara Khalid Al-Dossary, described Luvanga to BBC Sport Africa as a great player and colleague but also revealed another of her talents: she is a great dancer.

Now Luvanga is taking both her football and her personality to the United States.

Her move to the Washington Spirit makes her the first Tanzanian woman to play in the NWSL, another significant milestone in the internationalisation of Tanzanian women's football.

She will also enter a dressing room containing a sizeable African contingent, with the Washington Spirit's roster now featuring seven African internationals.

For all her success at club level, Luvanga has not enjoyed the same impact in Tanzania colours at senior international level. Her 12 goals for Tanzania have come at youth level — 10 for the U-17 side and two for the U-20 team, while fitness problems have limited her involvement around the past two Women's Africa Cup of Nations campaigns.

articles.title: Derek McInnes says Rangers must get fans on side against Celtic in League Cup and sets target to become 'relevant again'
articles.summary: Rangers host Celtic at Ibrox in Sunday's League Cup quarter-final in manager Derek McInnes' first Old Firm as manager; there will be no away fans after SPFL ruling; Celtic have won all six league games heading into clash while Rangers have four consecutive Premiership wins after poor start
articles.body:
The anxiety from the Light Blues legions, which has been prevalent in some games in Govan, resurfaced on Wednesday night as the home side struggled in the second half of the Scottish Premiership clash against St Mirren after missing a host of chances before the break.

However, a pressure valve was released when substitute Bojan Miovski scored in stoppage time for a crucial 1-0 win to make it four victories in a row for McInnes and his side.

Only Rangers fans are allowed in the 50,000-capacity Ibrox for the League Cup quarter-final against Celtic at the order of the authorities amid a ticket allocation spat between the two Glasgow giants .

Former Rangers midfielder McInnes, looking forward to his first Old Firm game as boss, is hoping for positivity from the Gers supporters.

He said: "I think we've got to bring the crowd with us.

"You're not going to play Celtic and dominate the game for 90 minutes. We'll have spells, they'll have spells, it's just the way it is.

"I think it's important that we tap into having that 50,000 behind us and be behind the players, support them, have their backs, not be on their backs and really make it as tough for Celtic as possible.

"We've got our part to play in that and I felt that if we can capitalise on good play and good opportunities, which we didn't do last night and we didn't do against Motherwell (also won 1-0) obviously, if we can get ourselves in front, give the crowd something to get behind, then I think the strength of our club can be shown.

"I think if the 50,000 can be utilised and we can have the strength of performance in the team that will help the team, it will be difficult to stop.

"There's been a lot of frustration over a period of time at the club and it's up to us to try and show that we're going to deliver something a bit different.

"We recognise Celtic are a good team who have been the main title winners and the team that's picked up more trophies than any other club in recent years.

"We just want to make sure that we give ourselves a chance to be relevant domestically again in terms of winning trophies, and Sunday gives us a chance to take a step towards that."

Greek outfit Aris Thessaloniki are in talks to sign Rangers defender John Souttar .

The 29-year-old signed a new deal until 2027 earlier this year, with Rangers retaining the option to extend that by a further 12 months.

However, Sky Sports News reported during the summer transfer window that the Scotland international has been made surplus to requirements at Ibrox.

Souttar was left out of the club's pre-season trip to Spain and has not featured under new boss McInnes.

The Greek transfer window in Greece shuts on Tuesday.

McInnes added: "I spoke to John this morning, he trained.

"There's a bit of interest in him from one or two clubs. One club maybe a bit further down the line than the other but I think it's something that could develop.

"I don't think it's at that stage yet but maybe something will happen over the next two or three days."

articles.title: Los límites salariales de la 26-27: récord del Real Madrid y nuevo subidón del Barcelona
articles.standfirst: LaLiga publicó este jueves el dinero que puede gastarse cada equipo en su plantilla
articles.summary: LaLiga publicó este jueves el dinero que puede gastarse cada equipo en su plantilla
articles.body: una vez terminado el mercado de verano, LaLiga publicó este jueves los Límites de Coste de Plantilla Deportiva (LCPD), lo que comúnmente se denomina como límites salariales. Es decir, lo que cada equipo puede gastar en su plantilla en relación a sus ingresos, sus gastos y sus deudas. En esta última actualización, el Barcelona, ya regido bajo la regla del 1/1, sigue subiendo y pasa de los 432 millones del pasado mercado de invierno a los 582 millones. Eso sí, se mantiene todavía por detrás del Real Madrid, que como en los últimos mercados es el club que más puede gastar en su plantilla. El club blanco pasa de los 761 millones que había tenido en los dos últimos mercados a 832, lo que supone un récord. Tercero está el Atlético, que podía gastar 336 millones en su plantilla de acuerdo a los datos ofrecidos en el mercado de invierno y que ahora sitúa su límite salarial en los 361 millones. El club rojiblanco, que llegó incluso a ser segundo en algún mercado anterior, se aleja del Barcelona tras la recuperación azulgrana. El Sevilla continúa siendo el equipo de LaLiga EA Sports que menos puede gastar en su plantilla, apenas 20 millones. El Málaga, con 33 millones y el Alavés con 43, le siguen por abajo. El Deportivo, recién ascendido, se sitúa en los 64 millones de límite salarial, más que equipos como Osasuna, Espanyol, Elche, Rayo o Getafe. En Segunda, el Girona y el Mallorca, con 35 y 34 millones de LCPD, se sitúan muy por encima del resto. Oviedo, el otro descendido, y el Leganés, con 20, son los siguientes. El Almería es el equipo que menos puede gastar en su plantilla, apenas 3,9 millones. Muy cerca, el Granada (4 millones) y el Cádiz (4.6). El límite de coste de plantilla deportiva indica lo que un club se puede gastar en jugadores, primer entrenador, segundo entrenador y preparador físico del primer equipo (plantilla inscribible) y en filiales, cantera y otras secciones (plantilla no inscribible). Los conceptos que se incluyen en el límite de coste de plantilla deportiva inscribible y no inscribible son: salarios fijos y variables, seguridad social, primas colectivas, gastos de adquisición (incluidas comisiones para agentes) y amortizaciones. Para calcular el Límite de Coste de Plantilla Deportiva de un equipo, se tienen en cuenta los ingresos presupuestados de cada club (abonos, ingresos por taquilla, contratos comerciales, derechos de televisión, traspasos de jugadores, previsión de dónde llegará en Champions...) y a eso se le resta los gastos no deportivos presupuestados (alquiler de oficinas, nóminas de personal no deportivo, luz, internet...), el pago de las deudas que tenga y las pérdidas que arrastre de la temporada anterior. El resultado de esa operación es el Límite de Coste de Plantilla Deportiva, lo que el club puede gastar en su plantilla.

articles.title: Acusan a Eto'o por malversación de fondos
articles.standfirst: Exintegrantes de la Federación le acusan de haberse apropiado 500.000 euros de un amistoso contra Rusia
articles.summary: Exintegrantes de la Federación le acusan de haberse apropiado 500.000 euros de un amistoso contra Rusia
articles.body: La polémica sigue acompañando a la gestión de Samuel Eto'o. El presidente de la Federación camerunesa (Fecafoot) y miembro del Comité Ejecutivo de la Confederación Africana de Fútbol (CAF) está acusado de malversación de fondos. Según informa 'The Times', el exatacante de Real Madrid, Leganés, Espanyol, Mallorca y Barcelona habría desviado alrededor de 500.000 euros, pertenecientes a un amistoso contra Rusia disputado en octubre de 2023, a una de sus cuentas bancarias personales, en el Qatar National Bank en Doha. El diario inglés, de hecho, incluye documentos que acreditan ambos pagos, uno por valor de 455.056 euros y un segundo de 112.514. Sin embargo, casi tres años después, no hay ni rastro de ninguno. "Que yo sepa, no existe ninguna prueba contable ni bancaria que demuestre que los fondos transferidos a la cuenta personal de Samuel Eto'o en Qatar se transfirieran posteriormente a una cuenta oficial de Fecafoot o se registraran en sus libros contables", denuncia Guibai Gatama, exmiembro de la Federación camerunesa a 'The Times'. “Ni Fecafoot ni Samuel Eto'o han negado la existencia o autenticidad de estas transacciones, ya que los documentos son irrefutables”, insiste Gatama, que, al igual que otros miembros de la Federación expulsados durante el mandato de Eto'o, denunciaron la situación ante el Comité de ëtica de la FIFA. Sorprende, sin embargo, que, después de más de un año, no hayan recibido ninguna respuesta.

articles.title: El Rayo continúa la puesta a punto
articles.standfirst: Los operarios siguen realizando labores de mantenimiento del césped en el estadio de Vallecas. El objetivo del club, jugar por fin en casa ante el Espanyol
articles.summary: Los operarios siguen realizando labores de mantenimiento del césped en el estadio de Vallecas. El objetivo del club, jugar por fin en casa ante el Espanyol
articles.body: Enésimo día del culebrón con el estadio de Vallecas. El próximo sábado día 12 de septiembre, el Rayo acudirá al Bernabéu, pero todas las miradas están puestas en el enfrentamiento ante el Espanyol del día 15. Mientras que el cuadro franjirrojo sigue esperando ese informe de la Comunidad de Madrid que acredite que el campo está apto para jugar, siguen los trabajos de los jardineros sobre el césped para ultimar su puesta a punto para el duelo ante los ‘pericos’. Mientras que el deseo y el parecer del equipo es que el encuentro ante el Espanyol se dispute en Vallecas, la opinión de otros trabajadores del club es más pesimista y creen que el encuentro se disputará en Butarque, al igual que los choques ante el Deportivo Alavés y el Racing de Santander, según pudo saber MARCA. El tira y afloja con la Comunidad de Madrid continúa. En las últimas horas, el asunto del estadio de Vallecas se ha recrudecido. Por un lado, el Rayo Vallecano ha interpuesto un recurso al CSD para que se levante la extinción cautelar de la concesión. Mientras tanto, el Ayuntamiento de Leganés se ha pronunciado y el alcalde ha indicado que le va a cobrar una cifra de 50.000 o 60.000 euros al cuadro franjirrojo por cada encuentro que se dispute en Butarque para destinarlos a los servicios públicos. Después del parón de selecciones que detendrá la disputa de la competición doméstica del 20 de septiembre al 9 de octubre, el Rayo Vallecano se enfrentará contra el Athletic Club. Este duelo ha sido fijado por LaLiga para que se dispute el sábado 10 de octubre a las 14:00 horas en casa rayista. Este podría ser el primer duelo que se dispute en el estadio de Vallecas de la temporada, si no ocurre lo contrario en el partido ante el Espanyol.

articles.title: Asencio empieza de cero
articles.standfirst: El central vuelve al grupo en un intento de remontada saliendo último en la lista de centrales y con el cartel de transferible colgado durante todo el verano
articles.summary: El central vuelve al grupo en un intento de remontada saliendo último en la lista de centrales y con el cartel de transferible colgado durante todo el verano
articles.body: Asencio vuelve a empezar. El central se ha reincorporado al trabajo con el grupo tras una pretemporada accidentada, marcada por dos lesiones y por cuestiones extradeportivas. El defensa se pone a las órdenes de Mou en un intento de remontada deportiva que se antoja complicado: saliendo último en la lista de centrales (por detrás de Huijsen, Konaté y Rüdiger, y de Militao cuando el brasileño regrese) y tras tener el cartel de transferible colgado durante todo el verano. Es un regreso delicado para Asencio porque le toca empezar de cero. El 'boom' de su espectacular aparición en el primer equipo se ha esfumado y ha perdido mucho del terreno que tenía ganado. Todo ello tras unos últimos meses en los que ha perdido gran parte del protagonismo que tenía en el equipo. En febrero empezó una cuesta abajo que hasta el momento no ha podido detener. Sólo nueve partidos disputados desde entonces lo han devuelto prácticamente a la casilla de salida. Ocho meses difíciles a los que quiere dar carpetazo. Su regreso al grupo en la primera sesión de trabajo del equipo pensando en el Rayo es el punto de partida de Asencio para hacer borrón y cuenta nueva. Una fisura en la tibia que empezó a condicionarlo a principios de año fue el comienzo de todo. El central no se quiso bajar del barco en un momento de dificultad del equipo y se jugó el tipo por estar disponible. Pero la lesión lo limitaba muchísimo. Luego llegaría su polémico desencuentro con Arbeloa, que motivó su ausencia en varias convocatorias. Una serie de circunstancias que oscurecieron su temporada y lo llevaron a estar en la rampa de salida. La pretemporada y la llegada un nuevo entrenador no ayudó a que Asencio recuperase el terreno perdido. Más bien todo lo contrario. Por un lado, las lesiones lo volvieron a frenar. Por otro, la polémica de su condena por conducir ebrio, dando una tasa de alcohol que casi multiplicaba por cuatro el máximo permitido, complicó aún más su situación. El propio Mourinho no dudó en darle un serio toque de atención. "Un jugador del Real Madrid es jugador del Real Madrid 24 horas al día, 7 días a la semana y 12 meses al año. Todo lo que haces fuera, sigue siendo Real Madrid. Continúa dañando el prestigio de un club que es intocable. No estoy feliz y errores todos hacen, pero errores acumulados es diferente".

articles.title: Matheus Fernandes interview: Spurs midfielder on the passion of head coach Roberto De Zerbi and trophy ambitions
articles.summary: Tottenham searching for first goal and first win of the Premier League season but £85m Matheus Fernandes says the squad with "a lot of quality" is aiming to fight for trophies; watch Tottenham vs Everton live on Sky from 5pm on Saturday; kick-off 5.30pm
articles.body:
The £85m midfielder was wanted by a list of clubs after impressing for West Ham last season, with Man Utd keen on a deal but ultimately unable to go head-to-head with Spurs on the fee.

For Fernandes, it was his conversations with head coach Roberto De Zerbi which persuaded him the north London project was for him.

"I spoke with the Mister and he was the key for this decision," Fernandes told Sky Sports ahead of the Saturday Night Football clash with Everton.

"You can feel when you speak with him, the energy, the passion about football.

"He spoke with me, he spoke with my dad, he spoke with my mum. So it was not just about me, it was about the people around me. He said to my dad, 'we'll take care' [of] me.

"He's a top manager. You can feel on the pitch, off the pitch as well. And I'm very happy to work with him."

Fernandes made his feelings for De Zerbi clear to the Spurs boss himself when the deal was done.

"The first day of the pre-season, I met him and he was very happy. I was very happy as well for playing for him. I said, 'Look, I chose Tottenham because one of the biggest parts was you'."

It wasn't just De Zerbi's way with words. The Italian's style of football also impressed Fernandes. "For me as a midfielder, I like so much," he said.

Fernandes believes the quality of the Spurs squad can raise his own level of performance, too.

"I believe that I can be a much better player than I was last season," said the 22-year-old Portuguese, who recorded three goals and four assists in the Premier League for the Hammers.

"If you look at the squad, it's a big team with big players, important players, players with experience, players with a lot of quality. So, when you play with better players, I think you play better. So, I believe that I can be much better."

Spurs' players have been unable to turn that perception into more than one point so far. But, despite substantial criticism in the early weeks of the season, Fernandes is full of belief the team will soon start to prove their doubters wrong - and deliver in a significant way.

"I know what it's like: when you win, you are the best. When you lose, you are the worst," he said.

"We just focus on us. If you believe in the club, if you believe in the manager, you know that you need to take some time to learn the timings, everything tactical, and when you arrive there, it's like ketchup. It starts spilling."

Fernandes' first two seasons in English football have ended in relegation, at Southampton and then West Ham. But he is at Tottenham to win.

"This is one of the reasons that I came here, to play for winning something," he said.

"We want to win the games, we want to fight for the titles and, with this squad, it's normal that we want to fight for the titles.

"Now, we didn't win the last three games, so things need to calm. We need to take time. And then, like I said, it's like ketchup, when you win one game, it's going to be more easy."

Fernandes, his Spurs colleagues and the club's supporters will hope that starts on Saturday.

articles.body:
The Michigan Wolverines opened the 2026 college football season inside the Top 25, sitting at No. 16 in the AP Poll . Then came a 13-12 escape against the Western Michigan Broncos , and Michigan fell out of the AP Top 25 entirely ahead of its Week 2 meeting with No. 11 Oklahoma .

The AP voters were not the only ones to move on. CBS Sports had Michigan ranked No. 15 entering Week 1.

CBS Sports Drops the Michigan Wolverines to No. 37

Chip Patterson of CBSSports.com re-ranked every team in the country entering the second week of the college football season. One of the biggest movers was Michigan, which slid 22 spots, from No. 15 all the way down to No. 37.

There's no way to carry the same rating or ranking for Michigan from Week 1 to Week 2 after watching that offensive performance from the Wolverines against Western Michigan. The drama and controversy surrounding the extra second on the clock and the mulligan Hail Mary attempt may have actually overshadowed how distressing the Wolverines' performance was in the context of hoping to see a Big Ten dark horse or College Football Playoff contender. Michigan is a good team, but four quarters of football did not show much evidence of being a great team. Those good-but-not-great teams usually wind up here, somewhere between No. 30 and No. 50, until they prove otherwise on the field. articles.title: Cortez Braham lawsuit dismissed, NCAA cannot punish Memphis with 'rule of restitution'
articles.summary: A federal court on Sept. 9 dismissed a lawsuit between former Memphis football receiver Cortez Braham and the NCAA.
articles.body:
A federal court on Sept. 9 dismissed a lawsuit between former Memphis football receiver Cortez Braham and the NCAA, ending a legal saga that stretched on for more than a year.

Braham initially sued the NCAA in 2025 to get an additional year of eligibility. He was granted a preliminary injunction before transferring to Memphis, where he was the Tigers' leading receiver in 2025. After the season ended, Braham's lawyers filed a motion to dismiss the lawsuit.

The NCAA fought it, saying in legal filings that it wanted to enforce the "rule of restitution" against Memphis for playing a player they said should have been ineligible. Lawyers for both sides argued their cases in a Las Vegas courtroom in March.

Charles Huff, Memphis Tigers football coach in first season

A ruling finally came on Sept. 9, when the panel of judges ruled that the case was moot and dismissed it.

"Famously, in sports, "it ain't over 'til it's over." But, in this case, it's over," Judge Gabriel P. Sanchez wrote. "The game clock has run out on the 2025 college football season. With these appeals, the NCAA attempts one last Hail Mary pass: asking us to reverse the preliminary injunctions granted to these college football players that allowed them to play in the now complete 2025 season. Because these injunctions have already expired and these players' collegiate careers are over, no effective relief can be granted to the NCAA. We therefore dismiss these appeals as moot."

The ruling means the NCAA cannot punish Memphis for playing Braham during the 2025 season.

The judges also dismissed a case involving former San Diego State player Tatuo Martinson that had been combined because it dealt with the same issues.

I think Michigan State showed a lot in the win over Toledo, now is the time to put it together. Eastern Michigan just lost to San Jose State at home. The Spartans should roll here, or else we have some problems.

The reserves see some game action in the second half, which results in former Michigan State quarterback turned Eagle Noah Kim find the end zone in his return to Spartan Stadium. Still, Michigan State looks impressive and moves to 2-0 on the year with a monster road test at Notre Dame looming.

articles.title: Harry Kane confident Bayern Munich close to winning Champions League
articles.summary: Kane knows FC Bayern’s close to winning the Champions League.
articles.body:
Bayern Munich came so close last season. After winning the Bundesliga title, they very nearly booked their place in the Champions League final, but wound up losing 6-5 on aggregate to eventual winners Paris Saint-Germain after two action-packed semifinals legs, the first of which having ended 5-4 in favor of PSG in Paris.

Bayern still went on to secure the domestic double, but they were so close to achieving yet another historic treble, following in the footsteps of 2020 and 2013. A little bit of better luck on their side could've pushed them through to the final in Budapest, but they were ultimately left to rue missed chances in either semifinals leg and left with key talking points from questionable refereeing decisions. That's all history now, though.

Ahead of this season's Champions League campaign kicking off, Bayern are looking to shake off some frustration from their 0-0 draw at Schalke in the Bundesliga and as they first square off against Norwegian side Bodø/Glimt. Ahead of their European campaign getting underway, Harry Kane said he believes the German Rekordmeister are close to being at the level to win the Champions League this season.

"Yes, we're really close. I think last year was the finest of margins – to go out to a team who has won the Champions League back-to-back. There's no shame in that. We're coming into this season now saying that it needs to be our year. We need to find a way to get it done," Bayern's number 9 told TNT Sports (via @iMiaSanMia ).

As is now often the case with the new format of the competition, Bayern does face some heavy hitters in the competition after they start off with favorable matchups against Bodø/Glimt and Viking. Tricky ties against Arsenal and Atlético Madrid lay in wait after their first two matches, and later on in 'league phase' play, they face the likes of Real Betis , Manchester United , Lille ; all arguably far more tricky matches than Bodø/Glimt and Viking.

There's no reason why Bayern should not automatically progress to the knockout stages, but it's also worth remembering that PSG went on to win the competition in 2025 and last season after having to go through the playoff rounds. Last season, they beat fellow Ligue 1 side AS Monaco in the playoff rounds while having done the same against Brest in 2025.

articles.body:
Última hora del Bayern - Bodo/Glimt en directo

¡¡¡ Muuuuuuuuuuy bueeeeeeeenas a tod@s !!!

Bayern y Bodø/Glimt se estrenan en la presente edición de la UEFA Champions League con aspiraciones muy diferentes. El conjunto dirigido por Vincent Kompany quiere volver a disputar una final, algo que no consigue desde 2020. El pasado curso se quedó a las puertas de la última cita tras caer en semifinales ante el PSG . El conjunto noruego, por su parte, busca repetir la gesta de la pasada temporada, cuando alcanzó los octavos de final en su debut en la máxima competición continental.

El conjunto bávaro llega al partido después de empatar sin goles ante el Schalke 04 . Tras un inicio de temporada prácticamente perfecto, el Bayern quiere recuperar su pegada en su estreno europeo y comenzar con una victoria el camino hacia el objetivo de terminar entre los ocho primeros de la fase liga. Los de Kompany parten, un año más, entre los grandes favoritos para levantar la 'Orejona', con grandes jugadores como Kane, Olise, Luis Díaz y compañia.

Los noruegos vuelven a disputar la Champions después de una gran puesta en escena en su debut. Los noruegos alcanzaron los octavos de final tras eliminar al Inter en el playoff , aunque terminaron cayendo ante el Sporting CP . Ahora quieren volver a sorprender a Europa. Para llegar a la fase liga tuvieron que superar al NEC Nijmegen en la previa y afrontan el duelo en Múnich en un gran momento de forma: acumulan 20 partidos oficiales sin perder desde la derrota ante el Molde en mayo.

No queda nada para que ruede el balón en el Allianz Arena . ¡Suerte a ambas aficiones!

articles.body:
Manchester United begin their return to Champions League action by hosting Azerbaijani newcomers Sabah FK at Old Trafford on Thursday in their league phase opener.

The Red Devils have not played in Europe's top competition since they were bounced in the group stage of the 2023/24 tournament, with four defeats in six games to the likes of Bayern Munich , FC Copenhagen, and Galatasaray. They were on the outside of all three UEFA tournaments last season, but returned to the Champions League field by finishing third in the Premier League.

They meet Sabah, a club which has only been in existence since 2017, and is competing in its first-ever league phase of any European competition. They are famously coached by Valdas Dambrauskas, who has gone viral for his rise to coaching prominence by working his way up after winning money on a Lithuanian game show.
